unanswered.name: Marco Galvan Duque (MarcoGalvanD)
unanswered.text: Terrible experience. The service at the bar was indifferent - the bartender acted as though he were doing me a favor by serving me. The food is far too expensive for the quality and presentation. I ordered a grilled chicken wedge salad and received, quite literally, a huge chunk of iceberg lettuce.
unanswered.context: Surfaced by SpotHopper 2026-09-16T19:29Z. No businessprofile-noreply notification for this one -- caught via SpotHopper only. Same reviewer also uploaded photos to the profile Sep 16 21:18Z.
unanswered.draftReply: Marco, that's not the bar experience or the plate we want going out, and I'm sorry. The wedge should come dressed, garnished and portioned properly - if it went out as a bare chunk of iceberg, that's on us, and I'm talking to both the bar and the kitchen about it. I'd like to make it right if you'll give us another shot. - Joal, Owner

unanswered.name: Andy Watts
unanswered.text: We had fish and chips, oh my days, stunnning. And great service too. Best fish and chips Ive experienced.
unanswered.draftReply: Andy, best fish and chips you've had is a hell of a thing to hear -- our cooks will be insufferable now. Thanks for calling out the service too. Come back hungry. -- Joal, The Brewhouse

unanswered.name: Greg Quinn
unanswered.text: The Brewhouse has amazing, fresh food menu selections at very reasonable prices and the adult beverages hit the spot. I am a pilsner/lager guy and the one I had was so good I ordered one more. I thought the nachos were on point and the Schnitzel comes with 3 sauce options that are gourmet. Fresh seafood will be my go to next time. The staff is awesome and I even got to meet one of the owners who informed me The Brewhouse is the longest-running bar in SB, and soon they'll be able to craft their own spirits!
unanswered.draftReply: Greg, a pilsner guy going back for a second round is the highest praise a brewery can get. Glad the nachos and the schnitzel sauces hit the mark too, and thanks for the kind words about the crew. Come back for the seafood and we'll pour you a cold one. -- Joal, The Brewhouse

unanswered.name: M
unanswered.draftReply: Hi M, thanks for stopping by and for the rating. Three stars tells us something was just okay, and we'd like to know what so we can fix it. If you're up for it, email us at mojobrewhouse@gmail.com. Hope to see you again. -- Joal, The Brewhouse

unanswered.name: Luke Mayer (Cheez boi)
unanswered.text: The coffee was good. The everything bagel was exceptional, perfectly toasted to light crunch on the outside with a soft an chewy interior and a generous topping of melting butter alongside a prodigal portion of cream cheese. The breakfast burrito was simply exquisite, containing the perfect ratio of scrambled egg, bacon, avocado, sour cream, breakfast potato, cheese, and salsa on the side.
unanswered.draftReply: Luke, that may be the most thorough bagel review we have ever received and we are keeping it. Glad the burrito ratio landed right too. Come back hungry.

unanswered.name: Isabel Osmundsen
unanswered.draftReply: Isabel, thank you for the five stars. Next time you are in, tell us what you had so we can make sure it keeps being that good. See you soon.

unanswered.name: Justin Ladner
unanswered.draftReply: Justin, five out of five on food, service and atmosphere is about as good as it gets. Thanks for taking the time to rate us. Hope to see you back on Montecito soon.

unanswered.draftReply: Thank you for the coffee shout out, and glad the kids hit the muffins fresh out of the oven. That is the best window of the day around here. Come see us again.

toastPrevDay.note: FRI SEP 18 IS NOW COMPLETE -- AND THE FRAMING CHANGES. It is still the best day of the month in absolute dollars (net $6,971.75 / gross $7,278.75, +24.1% on Thursday), but against its own benchmark it was a SOFT Friday: net -15.0% vs Fri Sep 11 ($8,206.35) and -7.1% vs the 4-Friday average ($7,504.78). Guests held (290, -1.7% SDLW) and orders actually rose (186, +6.3% SDLW) -- the gap is entirely SPEND PER HEAD: $24.04/guest vs $27.82 SDLW (-13.6%) and avg check $35.39 vs $41.87 (-15.5%). Same bodies, smaller tickets. THE LABOUR NUMBER IS THE REAL WIN: $1,232.49 = 17.7% of net, against 25.5% on the same Friday last week -- $862 less labour on 290 guests. Dinner carried 74.5% of net ($5,199.50), lunch 20.4% ($1,423.25), espresso 5.0% ($349.00). Patio was the efficiency star at $88.87 net/order. Voids $123.00 (13 items / 11 orders) vs $159.50 SDLW. Discounts $307.00 = 4.2% of gross, the highest rate of the week and up 7.1% on SDLW. Refunds $0.00, $100.00 gift cards, 0 open orders, no auto-clockouts.
